mechanism: Buprenorphine may induce CYP3A4 metabolism of ethinyl estradiol, potentially reducing oral contraceptive efficacy, while ethinyl estradiol may inhibit buprenorphine metabolism via CYP3A4, increasing buprenorphine levels.
action: Monitor for reduced contraceptive efficacy and consider backup contraception; monitor for buprenorphine side effects and adjust dosing if necessary.
